title: Shopify API version 2025-10 is unsupported
description: Shopify documents that the 2025-10 stable API version is unsupported after October 16, 2026 and recommends moving to a supported stable version.
oldBehavior: The integration selects Shopify API version 2025-10.
newBehavior: The integration selects a supported Shopify API version, with 2026-01 recorded as the reviewed replacement.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct static apiVersion value of 2025-10 with 2026-01.
Review URL paths, headers, SDK wrappers, and dynamically selected versions separately.

evidenceSources.summary: Shopify documents that API version 2025-10 is unsupported after October 16, 2026 and recommends a supported stable version.

review.notes: Approved only for direct static apiVersion literals represented by the executable transformation; URL, header, SDK, and dynamic-version applicability remain review-only.

assumptions: The official source establishes the retirement boundary and reviewed replacement version, but does not establish SDK-specific applicability.
Dynamic version selection and non-literal configuration require human review.
